name: singlet_immune_repertoire_repertoire_diversity_expansion
title: Repertoire diversity and clonal expansion
description: Estimates per-group clonotype diversity and clonal expansion from a clonotype label per cell, standardising sampling depth so groups of different size compare fairly. The default hill_coverage method returns a Hill-number profile with bootstrap intervals; plugin_indices are depth-sensitive comparators. Writes uns/repertoire_diversity, uns/rarefaction_curves or obs/clonal_expansion depending on method. Do not use without a clonotype label per cell, or to compare groups whose clonotype definitions differ.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Estimator. hill_coverage is the default; plugin_indices and chao1 are comparators; expansion_classes labels cells by clone size.

grouping.description: Column names and minimum group size. group_key may be composite, such as donor crossed with cell type.

clone_key.description: Column with the clonotype label; missing values mean unassigned and are excluded.

copy_key.description: Optional integer UMI or copy count per cell used as clone-size weight; null counts each cell once.

min_cells.description: Groups with fewer cells are reported as excluded, not dropped silently.

depth.description: Depth standardisation for hill_coverage and plugin_indices.

policy.description: coverage aligns sample coverage; uniform resamples groups to one size; none keeps raw values.

size.description: Common resampling size for uniform; null uses the smallest group.

hill_coverage.description: Options for the Hill profile: q grid, bootstrap replicates and confidence level.

q_step.description: Spacing of the q grid; the default gives 41 orders.

nboot.description: Bootstrap replicates for intervals; resampling uses the seed.

plugin_indices.description: Options for plug-in indices computed on observed clone sizes.

indices.description: Plug-in indices to report, chosen from the four listed values.

steps.description: Number of sampling depths between 1 and the group size.

expansion_classes.description: Options for clone-size classes per cell.

count_within_group.description: Count clone sizes within each group; false pools the dataset, as scirpy does by default.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for bootstrap resampling and uniform subsampling.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: computed inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example uns/repertoire_diversity. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed calls. Keys: method, n_groups, n_excluded_groups, n_undefined, target_coverage, q_levels. Never raw histograms.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
